KEY FEATURES

  • Seven Bedroom House
  • Secure Gated Property
  • Large Private Garden
  • Overlooking Richmond Park
  • Conveniently Located for Kingston University and schools
  • EPC Rating: D
  • 4 Bathrooms

FULL DETAILS

Call today to arrange a viewing! Available now!

Set behind electric gates and situated in an exceptional elevated position on Kingston Hill overlooking Richmond Park, this magnificent detached residence offers an outstanding family lifestyle in one of South West London’s most desirable locations.

The property boasts seven generously proportioned bedrooms and four well appointed bathrooms, providing flexible accommodation ideal for modern family living. Enjoy breathtaking views across Richmond Park, bringing a rare sense of space, greenery and tranquillity right to your doorstep.

Designed with both everyday life and entertaining in mind, the home features a spacious open plan kitchen that forms the heart of the house, complemented by ample living areas filled with natural light. Externally, the property benefits from a large private driveway and garage, offering excellent parking and storage.

Perfectly positioned close to a highly regarded selection of outstanding state and independent schools, as well as Kingston Uni Campus, this home will be particularly attractive to families and academics alike. With Kingston Hill’s leafy surroundings and easy access to Putney, Richmond and central London, this is a truly exceptional family home.

Please be advised that some photographs included in our marketing materials feature virtual staging techniques designed to illustrate the property’s potential appearance;

Useful Info:
Council Tax (Kingston): Band H
Deposit: 5 Weeks of the Agreed Rent
Holding Deposit: 1 Week of the Agreed Rent
